back_translation: The Spirit of the Lord GOD is upon me, because the LORD has anointed me to proclaim good news to the poor. He has sent me to bind up the broken-hearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives and release to the prisoners,
to proclaim the year of the LORD's favor and the day of our God's vengeance, to comfort all who mourn,

to provide for the mourners of Zion — to give them a beautiful crown in place of ashes, the oil of joy in place of mourning, a garment of praise in place of a despondent spirit. And they will be called oaks of righteousness, the planting of the LORD, for the display of his splendor.
They will rebuild the ancient ruins; they will restore the places long desolate; they will repair the ruined cities, desolate for many generations.
Strangers will stand and shepherd your flocks, and foreigners will be your plowmen and the keepers of your vineyards.
But you will be called the priests of the LORD; people will name you the ministers of our God. You will eat the wealth of the nations, and in their riches you will boast.

Instead of shame, my people will receive a double portion; and instead of disgrace, they will rejoice in their share. Therefore they will inherit a double portion in their land, and everlasting joy will be theirs.
For I, the LORD, love justice; I hate robbery and wrongdoing. I will faithfully give them their recompense and make an everlasting covenant with them.
Their offspring will be known among the nations, and their descendants among the peoples. All who see them will acknowledge that they are offspring the LORD has blessed.

I will rejoice greatly in the LORD; my soul will exult in my God. For he has clothed me with garments of salvation and wrapped me in a robe of righteousness, like a bridegroom wearing a beautiful crown in priestly fashion, and like a bride adorning herself with her jewels.
For as the earth brings forth its shoots, and as a garden makes what is sown in it spring up, so the Lord GOD will make righteousness and praise spring up before all the nations.
